motions.item_title: Motion to go into Closed Session
motions.text: That a closed meeting of Council be held on May 11, 2023 at 5:05 p.m., in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering a recommendation related to labour relations.
motions.text_html: That a closed meeting of Council be held on May 11, 2023 at 5:05 p.m., in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering a recommendation related to labour relations.

motions.item_title: Motion to Reconvene into Open Session
motions.text: That Council reconvene into Open Session.

That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo approve a tentative Memorandum of Settlement for the Region’s transit staff represented by Unifor Local 4304 for the period of May 1, 2023 to April 30, 2026.
motions.text_html: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo approve a tentative Memorandum of Settlement for the Region’s transit staff represented by Unifor Local 4304 for the period of May 1, 2023 to April 30, 2026.

motions.text: That A By-law to Confirm the Proceedings of the Council of the Regional Municipality of Waterloo at this Meeting Held on May 11, 2023. be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 23-022, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That A By-law to Confirm the Proceedings of the Council of the Regional Municipality of Waterloo at this Meeting Held on May 11, 2023. be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 23-022, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 5:22 p.m.
